title: wolfSSL CertFromX509 AuthorityKeyIdentifier size confusion heap-buffer-overflow
expected_vulnerable_behavior: On wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable with WOLFSSL_AKID_NAME and ASan/UBSan, a reconstructed DER X.509 certificate containing an oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension triggers AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow in CertFromX509 through wolfSSL_i2d_X509_bio.
expected_fixed_behavior: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable safely rejects the reconstructed DER X.509 certificate with oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier. wolfSSL_i2d_X509_bio returns 0, the harness exits with code 1, and no ASan heap-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 20046, or abort is observed.
expected_current_behavior: Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1373-g8fca95ce6 safely rejects the reconstructed DER X.509 certificate with oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier. wolfSSL_i2d_X509_bio returns 0, the harness exits with code 1, and no ASan heap-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 20046, or abort is observed.
crash_signal: ASan heap-buffer-overflow; WRITE of size 20046; memcpy; CertFromX509 src/x509.c:11863; wolfSSL_i2d_X509_bio trigger path; exit code 134.
migration_value: High. AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension parsing and X.509 internal conversion are relevant to cross-library X.509 parser comparison and structured mutation.
notes: Certificate-level strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable commit 922d04b3568c6428a9fb905ddee3ef5a68db3108. The reconstructed DER certificate uses a small 20-byte AuthorityKeyIdentifier keyIdentifier and an oversized full AKID source of approximately 20046 bytes. The vulnerable code checks authKeyIdSz but copies authKeyIdSrcSz into cert->akid, producing ASan heap-buffer-overflow in CertFromX509. Fixed release candidate verified: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable commit 1d363f3adceba9d1478230ede476a37b0dcdef24 safely rejects the oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier input without sanitizer crash evidence. Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1373-g8fca95ce6 commit 8fca95ce651d6e370d91f5598786de4bc66aa2c2 was tested with the same reconstructed oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier DER certificate. It safely rejected the input without sanitizer crash evidence.
